rulings.ruling: Ruling: interface gap; the reviewer was not given the federal dependent fields (dependent.claimed, dependent.one), which the New York text never names, and encoded zero. The project counts the dependents for whom dependent.claimed is true, the federal qualifying-child and qualifying-relative tests, which is the class item H lists: IT-201-I p. 6, Item H, "Enter the required information for each dependent you claimed on federal Form 1040. Also enter the required information for any dependent you were entitled to claim on your federal return but chose not to". No New York fact reads differently; not a defect.
